markers.name: Mount Pisgah settlement slope
markers.coord_source: Derived: about 370 m east of OSM relation 6150307 (Mount Pisgah Park), on the slope the Iowa state marker text (quoted in NPS Historic Resource Study ch. 7) describes
markers.note: Settlement layout unknown and almost nothing remains. State marker text: 'The original community was located on the slope and flat lands east of this spot'; Church History Sites page: homes and two log meetinghouses on a hillside above the fields. Point stands for that eastern slope, not a known building.

markers.name: Mount Pisgah cemetery, monument and park
markers.coord_source: Church location page 'Mount Pisgah Monument' map pin (41.051103, -94.101062); OSM relation 6150306 cemetery 41.05125, -94.10079
markers.note: Merged: cemetery/monument and the adjoining county park (OSM relation 6150307, 41.05003, -94.10083) are about 120 m apart, under the 156 m merge distance.
